messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the 2026-03-10 postmortem (missing spans + rollup inaccuracies). want explicit owners + short timelines so these remediation tasks close this sprint. postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
josh: i'll take the rollup join logic and the aggregator dedupe step. root cause looks like mixed null/default keys. i'll aim for a PR in 5 business days.
kevin: i'll handle the DB migration to populate safe defaults for service_id and add a small step to backfill historical keys. need coordination with infra for a low-traffic window. ETA 4 days to schedule + migration.
ella: i'll own the missing-span restore orchestration. propose `spans.restore.v1` with a 48h max-window per run (lower than previous attempts to reduce DB load). dry-run in 1 day, controlled run in 3 days, full phased restore in 10 days.
priya: i'll add a CI/regression that generates a tiny synthetic trace corpus and asserts rollup totals match expected aggregates within 8%. will block merges for rollup services. ETA 3 days.
ops-bot: recurrence note: similar gaps recorded 2025-10-12 and 2026-01-05. recurring pattern flagged; recommend periodic audit.
maria: owners summary: josh=join+dedupe (5d), kevin=db migration (4d scheduling), ella=restore backfill (1d dry-run / 10d phased), priya=CI test (3d). i'll update the remediation tracker and create a weekly check-in. confirm?
josh: confirmed. PR will include before/after delta graphs and an automated smoke to run in staging.
kevin: confirmed. will coordinate with infra for a midnight maintenance window to run migration.
ella: confirmed. will implement `--dry-run` and `--throttle=rate:1000/s` flags and an output report listing affected service/time ranges.
priya: confirmed. test will run in CI nightly and on PRs touching rollup code.
maria: ops ask: can we add a coverage sweep that runs every 4 hours and emits a coverage_ratio metric per service? cron `0 */4 * * *`. page if coverage_ratio < 0.80 for any top-20 service.
ops-bot: added: coverage-sweep `0 */4 * * *`. alert threshold set: <0.80 for top-20 services. paging enabled.
deploy-bot: deploy recorded: service=rollup-worker rolling-update v2.4.1 by josh at 2026-03-10T18:12Z (auto-rollback=enabled)
maria: final: i'll add a quarterly "rollup-assumptions-audit" calendar event, update postmortem with owners/times, and mark these P0/P1 items in the remediation tracker. weekly check-ins until closed. ping here if any timeline slips. :thumbsup:
